column1: # M3-ASSY-R12 inner planes (stage C, D-R12-22): In1.Cu is one GND plane over the whole board; In2.Cu is the 3V3 plane with
# three islands of other rails (higher priority, so the 3V3 fill keeps its clearance round them). Polygons in board mm,
# vertices in order; r12_route.py draws them and the drafting aid (r12_aid/plan.py) lands each rail's vias inside its own
# island. A pad of another rail inside an island reaches its own plane by a track out of the island.
